cover.title: A Day On My Plate
cover.sub: eating like a gamer who lifts: protein at every meal and no crazy restriction

slides.text:
oats with banana, walnuts and
peanut butter + black tea

post-gym cocoa pancakes with
greek yogurt, walnuts and honey

meal-prepped lunch: roasted potatoes,
broccoli and homemade meatballs

evening cacao instead of a 3rd coffee
(no jitters before stream)

and that's me fuelled for
a 5-hour stream 🎧
